title: PyGeoParallax-IN: cloud parallax correction for INSAT-3DR imagery over India
description: Open-source Python tool that corrects INSAT-3DR geostationary imagery for cloud parallax by ray tracing on the WGS84 ellipsoid (optionally with terrain), applies a navigation correction measured from coastlines, and writes uncorrected and corrected datasets on the same grid. Includes readers for INSAT-3DR L1C/L2B, GPM 2A Ku, ERA5 and SRTM, and tools to validate the correction against GPM radar.
